name: concord
description: Chat em tempo real estilo Discord: servidores, canais, DMs, voz, vídeo e compartilhamento de tela.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,desktop -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w desktop"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
